input.prompt: Animate the first frame exactly, same framing and characters. Rehearsed wushu partner set on a wet salt flat at sunset: orange copy (ponytail) left, violet copy (two buns) right, in guard. About 1.7 seconds in the violet copy alone throws a middle front snap kick at the orange copy's stomach. The orange copy does NOT kick: she lifts her front knee and sweeps her forearm down, parrying the shin aside past her hip. About 3.5 seconds in the orange copy counters with a straight punch in a bow stance, stopping short; the violet copy leans back and blocks with her forearm. About 4.6 seconds in both freeze. One kick only. Real weight and momentum; knees bend on every landing. Always exactly two separate people, two arms and two legs each; no limb appears, vanishes or detaches; bodies never pass through each other. The four small background figures stay in place. Static low side camera. One continuous shot, no slow motion, no text, mouths closed.
